title: Implement Library Route Map phase 3
summary: Add backend-authored Library Profile compare/diff evidence for route, path, video, subtitle, and audio settings.
reason: Operators need a safe profile-to-profile comparison before staging policy edits through the existing settings Preview/Save path.
behavior_before: Library Profile comparisons were implicit in individual controls and not exposed as a backend-authored diff.
behavior_after: A read-only compare endpoint and Libraries panel show explicit/inherited states, value equality, designation filtering, and changed fields between two profiles.
manual_validation: profile compare edge cases covered: explicit/inherited state, value equality, designation not-applicable rows
rollback_plan: Remove the compare builder route, WebView compare panel, related tests, summaries, and this change packet.
notes: Compare is evidence-only and does not write settings or create a new save route.
